name: Fusion map
corpus: synthetic photo-like scenes generated from fixed seeds (forensic.validation.run.scene)

detection.task: Which area was pasted in? (fusion of A-DJPG, NA-DJPG, dimples and noise)
detection.positives: 40 images per condition: first save at JPEG 50-79, an uncompressed area of 30% x 30% pasted, final save at 90 or 95
detection.negatives: the same 40 images untouched in three histories (see false_positive_rate_by_history)
detection.detected_means: an outlined area (belief above 0.55) covers at least 30% of the pasted rectangle

known_failure_modes: Only as good as its inputs: when no input's condition holds (single-saved file, no dimples) only the weak noise source remains.
Reliabilities are fixed, not learned; they are chosen from the inputs' own cards.
Inherits every input's false alarms on texture, flat areas and periodic content.
